insight: Started in 2020 as an open-source ML-monitoring library and expanded to LLM and RAG evaluation; Apache-2.0 licensed.
name: Evidently AI
tagline: Evaluation and observability for ML and LLM systems.
description: Evidently is an open-source Python framework for evaluating, testing, and monitoring AI systems — from tabular ML models to LLM apps, RAG pipelines, and agents. It ships 100+ built-in metrics covering data drift, quality, hallucinations, PII leaks, and jailbreaks, plus LLM-as-judge scoring and monitoring dashboards. Evidently Cloud adds a hosted service with no-code evals, alerting, and team management on top of the open library.

modelSupport.notes: Evaluation framework; LLM-as-judge runs against your choice of provider.

edge: One library spanning classic ML monitoring and LLM/RAG evals — 100+ metrics from data drift to hallucination — with an optional cloud.
pros: Covers both ML and LLM evaluation
Optional hosted cloud with free tier
cons: Cloud features gated to paid tiers
Reports can get heavy at scale
